annotations.title: Ask wooden house manufacturers for quotes

description: Sends a design to the Geoniks team, who forward it with the person's contact details to timber-house manufacturers that build in their country, so they receive real price offers by email. Requires the person's own email address and country, their explicit agreement that Geoniks may share their design and contact details with manufacturers (consent_to_share = true), and the five qualifying questions manufacturers need before quoting (construction_type, includes, budget, has_land, start) — ask the person all five before calling this tool; without any of them nothing is sent.

area_m2.description: Floor area in m², if there is no design_id.

budget.description: Required: total budget range — ask the person.

consent_to_share.description: true only if the person agreed that Geoniks shares their design and contact details with manufacturers.

construction_type.description: Required: preferred construction type (solid log vs. timber frame vs. not sure) — ask the person.

country.description: Country where they want to build. When signed in, the account's country is used if this is left out.

design_id.description: Id of a Geoniks design to send with the request.

email.description: The person's email address, as they gave it. Not needed when signed in with Geoniks (taken from the account).

has_land.description: Required: whether they already have a plot to build on — ask the person.

includes.description: Required: what the price should cover (building kit … turnkey) — ask the person.

notes.description: Wishes: budget, timing, plot, wood type, anything the manufacturer should know.

phone.description: Phone number with country code (optional; manufacturers often reply by phone).

start.description: Required: when they want to start construction — ask the person.

user_request.description: What the person asked for, in one short sentence in their own words (no contact details).

name: request_manufacturer_quotes
title: Ask wooden house manufacturers for quotes
